    a) Smooth Stone Slab Crafting: 3 smooth stones + 1 furnace → 6 smooth stone slabs

    a) From 2 smooth stone slabs to 6 smooth stones: 2 + 3 = 6 smooth stones
12. Finally, with 6 smooth stones, you can craft the smooth stone slabs:
    a) 3 smooth stones → 1 smooth stone slab

        i) To craft 1 smooth stone slab: Take 3 smooth stones → 1 smooth stone slab
       ii) Repeat i) two times: 3 more smooth stones → 2 more smooth stone slabs

1. Obtain an iron ingot by farming and smelting.
2. Craft a blast furnace using smooth stone (3 pieces) and a regular furnace (1 piece) along with 5 iron ingots.
3. Obtain 6 smooth stones slabs by crafting them in batches (since 6 slabs yield 1 stone).
4. Combine the 6 smooth stones slabs to get one smooth stone slab.
